title: THI social-feed
description: The single data contract between THI's ingest+movers-engine and the autoposter. The caption/write step consumes stories[] ONLY. Every figure carries source + as_of. See MOVERS-ENGINE.md.

week_mode.description: evergreen = max surprise_score below quiet_week_threshold; live formats must not generate (VALIDATOR G6b).

id.description: ZIP or county id, e.g. '78745' or 'Travis'

type.description: Grain of this area's readings. PHASE 2 AMENDMENT: `metro` and `state` added. THI resolves almost everything at metro grain and some feeds (electricity price) only statewide; labelling a statewide figure as county-level would be false precision, which the honesty gate forbids. The grain is stated rather than flattened.

metrics.description: Keys are metric names (drought_stage, hail_window, energy_cost_est, grid_stress, permit_signal, appraisal_change, insurance_trend). Gated metrics are ABSENT (not null) until their ingest lands.

stories.description: PRE-RANKED, surprise-scored candidate headlines. The caption/write step reads THIS, never raw areas[]. rank 1 = hub/article headline; next feed Movers/Wager/reels.

source.description: e.g. 'US Drought Monitor', 'Travis Central Appraisal District', 'NOAA/NWS SPC'

as_of.description: ISO date/datetime the figure is valid as of

vs_baseline.description: vs this area's rolling median (its normal)

vs_neighbors.description: this area's move vs median move of adjacent areas

why.description: plain-language justification; also the headline rationale and validator audit trail

figure.description: the EXACT string the caption may use verbatim, e.g. '+2 stages (now Stage 3)'. VALIDATOR G1 checks output numerals against this.

suppressed.description: true if flagged as glitch/big-but-boring/repeat; suppressed stories are dropped before the caption step
